resource: Native summon links one retirement call examines
allocation_impact: A per-call bound in ChannelRuntimeV1::retire_native_summons: the pass examines at most 256 links from a cursor kept with the links, in admission order and wrapping, and retires the dead children among them; the dead children past it keep their slots and links until a later call reaches them, so every link is examined within ceil(links / 256) calls. It never refuses: admit_native_summon first retires its own parent's dead children (at most 16, CREATUREAI0-RL-08), so a deferred retirement neither refuses a summon nor lets a parent hold more than 16 links. The retired slots leave the occupied index and the attacker leases in one pass per call. It reserves nothing.
boundary_tests: max=256: with 640 dead children one call retires 256
max+1: the rest retire on later calls, and an admission whose parent's dead children the next pass would not reach retires them first and succeeds
